import statistics
import math

on_budget = [760375, 789266, 841241, 922161, 999496, 1085271, 1186987, 1305621, 
             1382834, 1544455, 1483525, 1337730, 1258265, 1345040, 1575874, 
             1797946, 1932359, 1865279, 1450355, 1530058]
off_budget = [293885, 302426, 311934, 335026, 351080, 367492, 391989, 415800, 
              444468, 480583, 507519, 515321, 523842, 534744, 577475, 
              608382, 635088, 658045, 654010, 631688]

# Verify data ranges
print(f"On-budget range: {min(on_budget):,} to {max(on_budget):,}")
print(f"Off-budget range: {min(off_budget):,} to {max(off_budget):,}")

# Correlation check
n = len(on_budget)
x_mean = sum(off_budget) / n
y_mean = sum(on_budget) / n

# Covariance
cov = sum((xi - x_mean) * (yi - y_mean) for xi, yi in zip(off_budget, on_budget)) / n

# Standard deviations (population)
var_x = sum((xi - x_mean) ** 2 for xi in off_budget) / n
var_y = sum((yi - y_mean) ** 2 for yi in on_budget) / n
std_x = math.sqrt(var_x)
std_y = math.sqrt(var_y)

# Pearson correlation
corr = cov / (std_x * std_y)
r_squared = corr ** 2

print(f"\nCorrelation: {corr}")
print(f"R² = {r_squared}")
print(f"R² (4 decimals): {round(r_squared, 4)}")

# Also try sample correlation
std_x_s = statistics.stdev(off_budget)
std_y_s = statistics.stdev(on_budget)
cov_s = sum((xi - x_mean) * (yi - y_mean) for xi, yi in zip(off_budget, on_budget)) / (n - 1)
corr_s = cov_s / (std_x_s * std_y_s)
r_squared_s = corr_s ** 2
print(f"\nSample correlation: {corr_s}")
print(f"Sample R² = {r_squared_s}")
print(f"Sample R² (4 decimals): {round(r_squared_s, 4)}")
